reviews.x: Love that these pinks are similar to nude or neutral colors. I bought this set because I really liked the way the Mia shade looks.  My only dislike with this is the same dislike I have with other Zoya lighter shade polishes; that is that I have to apply 3 coats in order to rid of streaks and to prevent lumpiness. However, I’m still impressed because even with 3 coats, Zoya’s polish is still light as a feather!

Love love love. Zoya is always good polish: levels well, good brush, lasts long. And this quad is just perfect. The palest color (on index finger) is sparkly and very sheer (other colors are forgeous cremes). As shown is probably four coats because I wanted to wear all four as an ombre effect. Super satisfied.

I have been pleasantly surprised by this brand. I recently have been doing more research into beauty brands and product ingredients and have decided to be more mindful about my purchases. I decided to give this brand a try because it doesn’t use a lot of the toxic chemicals that many other brands use. I thought I might have to compromise quality for peace of mind but I have to say that so far this brand has to be one of the best I’ve ever used. I previously also bought the mini color lock system

I bought the Zoya, All Snuggled Up, along with the mini color lock system kits and used them immediately, while following the instructions on the packages. I have to say in my pictures the polish has been on 14 days with no flaking, chips, breakage in the polish or my natural nails. The only thing that has happened is that my nail has grown out, as you can see at the cuticles. I’m so impressed and I will be buying more Zoya colors in the future. reviews.t: Great deal, love these polishes, but nearly identical to another quad
reviews.x: I love Zoya polishes, and the holiday quads are a fantastic deal, when 1 bottle goes for $10 normally.  I would have loved this, except 3 of the 4 are almost identical to the pinks in another holiday quad, even though names are different.  The colors also appear differently in the description photos, Zoya website, and other reviews.  Overall, the quad price is awesome, but these are not returnable even though Prime, so if they don’t work out, they are not really worth being a great deal.  I alwa

I am so happy with this polish. I've been waiting to replace all my old polish with a great chemical free, or 'cleaner' polish and here it is! The coverage is great, dries quickly, and has great durability. Love these neutral/pink colors.
Great polish even for stubborn nails.  I have deep ridges and most polish chips within a day or two.  These last 4-5 days without any base or top coat.  Great product.

reviews.t: Great polish but not for my olive skin
reviews.x: This is a great product! I especially like the lightest, almost nude shade. I applied a base coat (Essie) first (separate purchase), followed by 3 thin coats of color and then followed by Essie gel setter top coat ( separate purchase). I waited a full 2 minutes in between coats and then a full hour of really not using my hands to let everything dry. I can go a full week with barely a chip. The colors are shimmer and the wrong color for my olive skin. I will only keep the lightest and will gift t

I love how easily this polish applies. I had seen other halal polishes that seemed goopy when you put them on but you don’t have that with Zoya. It does chip a bit quicker than conventional polishes, but that’s to be expected. I would be prepared to refresh your nails after 5 days to keep it looking A1. I love these quad sets too. Great value for the price.
Lasted only about 4 days then started chipping.

I love this polish and these colors are fantastic.  I used them throughout fall and winter and the darker colors are that perfect beety/maroon/brown color.  I guess I didnt realize the description well, because I thought  I was getting mini bottles.  This is not the case, you are getting FULL SIZE BOTTLES for this price.  Definitely looking to purchase more in different colors to get some more summery colors.  Quality was better than i expected for a eco friendly brand.  It still chipped on me b

These colors are beautiful and for the most part paint on very smoothly. The light shimmery pink is rather translucent with only one coat but with three coats is opaque. Unlike some of the other reviews, they are more muted purple/pink colors and really cannot pass as true nudes, even more so with my warm skin tone. But I think they are very low-profile, mature looking and wearable with most outfits including work clothes. I will definitely be using these a lot! I cannot speak for longevity but

This product is advertised as being 10 free, but the box it comes in says 5 free. I was super careful to check that it was 10 free, so I'm not super happy about the false advertising. This is also a non-refundable purchase.

reviews.t: Beware, this polish trashed my nails!
reviews.x: This “better for your nails” Zoya polish TRASHED my nails.  One thumbnail has a crater down the middle and the rest I had to trim off because they were in such poor condition after removing the nail polish.  I thought I was making a healthier choice, or as healthy is as possible in regard to nail polishes.  I really wanted this polish to live up to its’ promises.  It did not.

reviews.t: Love the brand and the options
reviews.x: For the money, the 10 free line is nice, colors are rich, wear well, and I have enjoyed them.  Would recommend along with Butter for good nail products.

reviews.t: Nice set, but very thick & gummy
reviews.x: All but the lightest shade in my set was very thick & gummy, nearly impossible to get a smooth coat. Note: NAIL POLISH CAN'T BE RETURNED.

I bought this set of 4 Zoya polishes.. I LOVE them!  I work outside in the garden and yard and am constantly touching up my nails..I tried other brands and this brand..ZOYA…is now my only brand I am ever going to use! I did my nails…2 coats of polish..slept on it..I put in 2 fence posts and a gate..I did all the labor…digging ..stretching the fence..tools used..and was totally surprised when this is what the nail polish looks like 3 days later!!  There is a little chipping on the very tip of my

🤎 ZOYA nail polish is exceptional! Doesn't chip extremely easily. 3 solid colors and one light pearl. The pic on my hand is the lightest solid pinky-nude. The color on my feet is the darkest eggplant kind of nude. You can add the sheer pearl over any of the solids, makes a beautiful glowy color. The one thing I don't care for is the brush. It's tiny, not the combo flat and narrow as on other brands. I can overlook this, as the polish itself is fantastic. Great price. No awful additional chemical

reviews.t: Beautiful colors, all easy to apply!
reviews.x: These 4 polishes are very beautiful! I’d say the colors can be used year round for work or casual. 1- Shimmer is a hint of pink shimmer that looks nice with 1 or 2 coats. 2- Mia is a perfect nude pink. 3- Madeline is a beautiful pinkish mauve. 4- Joni is a plum, grape-ish mauve. They all apply smoothly, self leveling, no streaks, no staining and don’t need more than 2 coats. Love them all!

Very disappointed in this item, as it was falsely advertised as 10 FREE, but it is actually only 5 FREE based on the ingredients on the package. Overall, the colors are cute, and they have lasted a week now.

Received nail polish today and I love the colors but they were broken. then found out I couldn't return because they were glass,  Have broken bottle can't replace or get refund.  Was they say buyer beware.

reviews.t: BE ADVISED THIS ITEM IS NOT ELIGIBLE FOR RETURN
reviews.x: BE ADVISED THIS ITEM IS NOT ELIGIBLE FOR RETURN. I didn't like the colors at all and now I'm stuck with this. The colors are darker in person than in the picture.

This is one of the healthiest nail polishes out there as it's free of 10 toxic chemicals, it's also Vegan :) with that said the formula is streaky, thick and prone to chip. I applied base coat, two coats and a top coat and the color started to chip and peel the next day. Fortunately the color was close to my natural color so it wasn't too obvious but still... and while this set is a bargain the quality is similar to the polishes found at the 99 cent store.   It was also hard to apply the polish

Never experienced such a terrible nail polish. Colours look nice on the package but when you receive it and look at it from close distance they are off, applied few times to see if it would have a smooth finish but it’s like being expired or a bad material and didn’t settle like a good nail polish. I also bought the prepping kit and one of the items didn’t even have the brush so how am I supposed to apply it? so with the fact that they don’t even accept returning defective units, I would suggest

Kinda pricey but it doesn't turn my nail weird colors like those other brands with whatever toxic chemicals they decide to throw in there. The snuggled up quad has the perfect colors for me. Lasts. a lot longer than other brands. I do a few coats and then it lasts weeks on my toes (pic). For fingers it lasts maybe like 5 days before chipping, but that's pretty good for me.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the polish quality, noting smooth application, good leveling, and long wear.
Many reviewers love the neutral/pink and purple shades, though some note the lightest shades are sheer and require multiple coats.
Several reviewers appreciate the cleaner, chemical-free formula, but one reviewer reported the box said 5-free instead of the advertised 10-free.
Some reviewers report chipping within about 4-5 days, while others experienced no chipping for up to 14 days.
A few reviewers note the colors are nearly identical to another quad or appear different from the description photos.
